KAPPASTWEAKS-FOR_THE_WORTHY.description: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold], then [gold]Enchant[/gold] [blue]{EnchantCards}[/blue] {EnchantCards:plural:card|cards} with [purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple].
KAPPASTWEAKS-FOR_THE_WORTHY.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-FOR_THE_WORTHY.title: For the Worthy
KAPPASTWEAKS-HAHA_BOMBA.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] potion {PotionSlots:plural:slot|slots}, then gain [blue]{Potions}[/blue] [purple]{PotionName}[/purple].
KAPPASTWEAKS-HAHA_BOMBA.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-HAHA_BOMBA.title: Haha Bomba
KAPPASTWEAKS-THE_SHINING.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Axes}[/blue] [purple]{AxeName}[/purple] and [blue]{Curses}[/blue] [purple]{CurseName}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
KAPPASTWEAKS-THE_SHINING.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-THE_SHINING.title: The Shining
KAPPASTWEAKS-GOTTA_CATCH_EM_ALL.descript: Card rewards from [gold]Combats[/gold] offer [blue]1[/blue] card from each character.
KAPPASTWEAKS-GOTTA_CATCH_EM_ALL.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-GOTTA_CATCH_EM_ALL.title: Gotta Catch 'Em All
KAPPASTWEAKS-FEAR_THE_REAPER.description: Enemies in your next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] {Combats:plural:combat|combats} will have 1 HP.
KAPPASTWEAKS-FEAR_THE_REAPER.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-FEAR_THE_REAPER.title: Fear the Reaper
KAPPASTWEAKS-FIRST_BLOOD.description: The first [gold]Attack[/gold] you play each [gold]Combat[/gold] hits all enemies.
KAPPASTWEAKS-FIRST_BLOOD.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-FIRST_BLOOD.title: First Blood
KAPPASTWEAKS-FUSION_GATE.description: You can now fuse [gold]Cards[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
KAPPASTWEAKS-FUSION_GATE.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-FUSION_GATE.title: Fusion Gate
KAPPASTWEAKS-PERFECT_COUNTER.description: If you perfectly [gold]Block[/gold] an enemy's [gold]Attack[/gold] deal the amount of damage back.
KAPPASTWEAKS-PERFECT_COUNTER.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
KAPPASTWEAKS-PERFECT_COUNTER.title: Perfect Counter
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONE_BOX.title: Bone Box
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONE_BOX.description: At the start of each combat, your open ends are [gold]0 | 0[/gold].
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONE_BOX.flavor: Every tile he owns rattles around in here. Some of them are his.
KAPPASTWEAKS-WORN_PIP.title: Worn Pip
KAPPASTWEAKS-WORN_PIP.description: The first time you [gold]Chain[/gold] each combat, draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
KAPPASTWEAKS-WORN_PIP.flavor: Rubbed smooth by a thousand nervous thumbs.
KAPPASTWEAKS-CHALK_BOARD.title: Chalk Board
KAPPASTWEAKS-CHALK_BOARD.description: Whenever your chain breaks, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
KAPPASTWEAKS-CHALK_BOARD.flavor: Every loss gets a tally. Every tally gets a lesson.
KAPPASTWEAKS-WILD_TILE.title: Wild Tile
KAPPASTWEAKS-WILD_TILE.description: The first domino each turn that would break the chain [gold]Chains[/gold] instead.
KAPPASTWEAKS-WILD_TILE.flavor: Nobody can agree what number it is. That's the point.
KAPPASTWEAKS-GOLDEN_SPINNER.title: Golden Spinner
KAPPASTWEAKS-GOLDEN_SPINNER.description: Whenever you [gold]Chain[/gold] a double, gain [blue]1[/blue] energy.
KAPPASTWEAKS-GOLDEN_SPINNER.flavor: The pin at its center has never stopped turning.
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONE_ABACUS.title: Bone Abacus
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONE_ABACUS.description: At the end of your turn, if you [gold]Chained[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] or more times this turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] energy next turn.
KAPPASTWEAKS-BONE_ABACUS.flavor: Counting on your fingers works better with spare fingers.
KAPPASTWEAKS-GRAVE_DICE.title: Grave Dice
KAPPASTWEAKS-GRAVE_DICE.description: Whenever a domino's pips are rolled, one side always matches an open end.
KAPPASTWEAKS-GRAVE_DICE.flavor: Dug up with their owner. Still warm with luck.
KAPPASTWEAKS-TILE_RACK.title: Tile Rack
KAPPASTWEAKS-TILE_RACK.description: Whenever you play a double, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
KAPPASTWEAKS-TILE_RACK.flavor: Keeps the good ones standing up.
